One of the Besr Restaurants in Town
Feb 2019 • Couples
Lu Bu's is a real find. Mediterranean food is not my first favourite food of choice but this restaurant is absolutely delicious. I have been several times and tend to stay with the same tapas as they are wonderful but will soon branch out and try the others not yet tasted. Favourites include piping hot meatballs in a rich tomato sauce, hummus with wonderful hot pitta bread and a pesto and olive oil dip, the halloumi, black olive \tomato salad and the patatas bravas. We also enjoyed the roast vegetables with a yogurt dressing. The halloumi salad is particularly small so you would need two to share with 2 to 3 people but the other dishes mentioned are quite plentiful and the patatas bravas are very generous indeed. The patatas bravas at Lu Bu's are the only potatoes eaten as a tapa where the potatoes are crisp on the outside and soft and fluffy on the inside - just as they should be. Other restaurants tend to serve this dish as an unappetising sogginess. The tapas at Lu Bu's are consistently good and normally piping hot, not an indifferent warm as is sometimes the case. The only tapa we haven't really enjoyed was the chicken on a skewer which has a strange reconstituted type texture and a not very welcome taste and texture of an abundance of what I believe to be dill. But this is a very minor thing compared to the other wonderful dishes. There is a very good selection of wine too and very well put together cocktails. My favourite is the Cayman cocktail which is not too sweet like other cocktails but is a more palatable vodka with muddled lime and ginger whose taste infuses beautifully on the palate. The Hemingway is also another delicious option. Final mention must be made of the staff and ambiance. The staff are professional but super friendly and welcoming and there is always a reasonable vibe lunchtime or evening, not so much inside which is empty on quiet weekdays but outside on their terrace is always full of people and has a Mediterranean feel to it. It is also never too hot outside as they have an abundance of fans. Altogether a delicious, relaxing experience for a chilled lunch time or evening.

This is a terrific restaurant that we can warmly recommend. Whether you're tired of local cuisine or just want a great non-Vietnamese dinner, this is the place to go in HCMC. It's somewhat outside of the central core but definitely worth the taxi ride.
The venue itself is pleasing in white colored minimalist style with comfortable seating and nicely set tables. Depending on the weather one can eat on the outdoor patio or inside.
Service is very good and attentive and the staff handles communication in English very well.
Above all, there is the great food in a well-varied menu that caters to many tastes. We went with some delicious starters and salads (especially good were the mushroom risotto and the village salad) followed by chicken souvlaki and a moist wonderful pan-fried pork chop. Desert was a scrumptious chocolate mousse. 
It would have been nice if the manager spent less time hovering over a neighboring table (of friends?) and devoted a bit of attention to other diners.
All in all a very nice experience that we would gladly repeat.
